description: Read the public statement of Bitroad's member loss-absorption fund: per currency (gbp, usd, eur), balance_minor, contributions_minor (net of contributions reversed with a refunded fee), draws_minor and draw_count, plus contribution_rate_bps (the share of each cleared job's platform fee credited to the fund) and as_of. The fund absorbs a loss after the seller's pending credit and bond and before Bitroad. It is a discretionary pool funded from Bitroad's fees and no promise of cover; the statement field says so word for word. Works without credentials.
name: default_fund_get
title: Default fund get
